description: Score resume text for applicant tracking system (ATS) compatibility. Returns a 0-100 score, a recruiter take, prioritized issues with concrete fixes, and detected strengths. Use for "is my resume ATS friendly", "why am I not getting interviews", or before tailoring to a specific job.

resumeText.description: Full plain-text resume. Use extract_resume_text first if you only have a file.

title: Check a resume against ATS rules
